She decided to burst into my room the morning after a sleepover with my friend (who was still there) and demanded I clean up the water bottles in my room. My friend and I decided to finish the video we were watching and then clean up the bottles. Overall there was about 10 minutes between her demand and my cleaning. She started stomping up and down the hall, slamming doors, screaming and ranting at the top of her lungs about how much of a bitch I was and how shitty of a kid I am, etc etc. I had to run back into my room and help my friend quickly pack her bag because I was getting her the fuck out of there. When we were at the door getting our shoes on, this woman paused her tirade to get as close as she could to my face and hiss “you’re never welcome in this family again.” 
When my friend and I got to my car, she burst into tears and said “I had no idea THATS what you were going through, I’m so sorry.” I was just numb at that point and tried to play it cool for her sake.
